description: H.264/HEVC/VP9/VP8 and AAC/Opus/Vorbis out of MP4 and Matroska, via FFmpeg. Carries native libraries for macOS, Linux and Windows on x86_64 and aarch64 under LGPL-2.1-or-later; see NOTICE-ffmpeg.txt in the jar. On any other platform the decoder reports itself unavailable and the rest of the toolkit is unaffected.
